headline: COURT 🏛️💥 CRUMBLES on LINDSAY CLANCY MURDER CASE 🧠😱
text:
‼️WAKE UP all you COURTROOM ⚖️📜 WATCHERS 🏛️👀‼️ LINDSAY CLANCY 👩‍⚖️ 3️⃣6️⃣ appeared in court 🧑‍⚖️ today after her MISStrial 💥 declared on 4️⃣ September when 📅 the jury 👥 hit a DEADlock 🗳️🚫 with one 🧍 lone HOLDout 🧍‍♂️ juror leaving 💥 everything in RUINS 🏚️😱 her lawyer 🧑‍⚖️ Kevin Reddington 🗣️ pushed hard 🔨 to DISMISS 🗑️ the entire 🔚 MURDER case 🔪 arguing the prosecution ⚖️ failed its BURDEN 📦 of proof 📜 and this whole 🌎 thing is pure ❓ SPECULATION 🕵️‍♂️💨 while prosecutors ⚖️ called it LAUGHABLE 😂 and insisted 📣 they MET ✅ their BURDEN 📦 showing Clancy 👩 was in a HEALTHY 🧠 mental state 🧠 when she killed 🪦 her three children Cora 🪦 5️⃣ Dawson 3️⃣ and Callan 🪦 8️⃣ months in their Massachusetts 🗺️ home 🏠😭 Judge William Sullivan 👨‍⚖️ demanded both ⚖️ sides get 📅 this thing 🏃 MOVING toward ➡️ a possible 🔄 retrial by the 2️⃣ November hearing 📅 but Reddington 🗣️ said he couldn't 🚫 even START 🏁 until June 📅 if it goes 🔄 again ‼️ The PSYCHOsis 🧠 defence that gripped 🫱 America now 🇺🇸 risks total 🏚️ COLLAPSE 🏛️💥 as DA ⚖️ Timothy Cruz 🧔 vows to do 📋 due diligence ✅ for the children

SEND 📩 this to 1️⃣0️⃣ of your JADEDDEST 😒 courtroom observers 👀
0️⃣ back = the case ⚖️ stays in DEADlock forever 🗳️🚫
5️⃣ back = the judge 👨‍⚖️ forces a retrial 🔄 date by November 📅🏛️
🔟 back = prosecutors ⚖️ finally decide 🤔 on retry 🔄 or full 🗑️ dismissal ⚖️😱
